user_direction.reference_strategy: use proven public/official browser-agent patterns as references, then independently improve BrowserCrew

verified_v0_2_improvements: one browser task maps to one task session
starting user tab is borrowed rather than owned
BrowserCrew-created tabs are task-owned and Chrome-grouped
borrowed/unrelated tabs cannot be closed by task-session cleanup
stable semantic @e refs and compact accessibility-style snapshots
native value setter for framework-controlled form fields

architecture_decisions.cdp_debugger: not added to core because Chrome does not allow debugger as an optional permission

next_action: Design and implement the BrowserCrew Local Bridge protocol for external agents, preserving task-session ownership and semantic refs. Keep raw CDP/debugger in a separately disclosed Advanced/Bridge distribution.
